# 1 Enoch Chapter 91 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** And now, my son Methuselah, summon all your brothers to me and gather all the sons of your mother, for the word calls me and the spirit is poured out upon me, that I may show you everything that shall befall you forever.

**2** Then Methuselah went and summoned all his brothers to him and assembled his kin.

**3** And Enoch spoke to all the children of righteousness and said: 'Hear, sons of Enoch, every word of your father, and listen rightly to the voice of my mouth. For I exhort you and say to you, beloved: Love uprightness and walk in it.

**4** Do not approach uprightness with a divided heart, and do not associate with the double-minded. Walk in righteousness, my sons, and it shall guide you on good paths, and righteousness shall be your companion.
